model.name: R20.24: Class detail links to its PUML file + rendered SVG preview.
model.description: A CLASS scenario unit's detail view MUST show: (a) link to the PlantUML .puml file where the class is defined, (b) rendered SVG preview of that PUML (inline or expandable). Both clickable/navigable. CLICKABLE in detail drawer: (a) clicking puml link opens the .puml file in browser/editor, (b) clicking SVG preview opens/expands the rendered SVG. Both navigable, not just text.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "each type has a link to a source file:line, classes to the puml file and the resulting svg preview, same as methods to the puml AND the ts code, same as tests and gates"

intendedChain.useCase: classDetail.pumlLink — Class shows puml file link + SVG preview
intendedChain.test: RED: open R20.24 detail → assert source link(s) present + clickable. Links must be CLICKABLE (navigate on click, not just text). Currently FAILS.

architectDesign.pattern: Class units have model.source.file pointing to the .puml diagram. Add a SECOND link to the rendered SVG (same basename, .svg extension). Both clickable: PUML opens in /edit, SVG opens as preview (ContentPreviewer or new tab).
architectDesign.impl: In the per-type detail rendering (rb-detail-view.ts or a dedicated rb-class-detail.ts), when sourceFile ends in .puml: render two links — (1) ✏️ PUML source → /edit/<path>, (2) 🖼️ SVG preview → /api/files/<path.replace(.puml,.svg)>
architectDesign.gate: Open a Class detail → PUML link + SVG preview both render and are clickable.
